name: Hermey
subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
description: Native client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent. Every bot (Hermes profile) is reachable through one gateway; approvals, streaming replies and tool output appear in the conversation. Builds are unsigned and must be re-signed by your sideloading app.

apps.name: Hermey
apps.subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
apps.localizedDescription: Chats with every Hermes bot, streaming replies, tool cards, inline approvals and per-device pairing.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Changed
- **No share-sheet entry.** It cannot work on a sideloaded install: a third-party signing certificate can carry
  an app-group entitlement but cannot provision the group id the extension needs, so the sheet could only ever say
  "no shared storage yet". The extension, the entitlement and the wiring are removed.

### Fixed
- **The expanded Live Activity is no longer an empty black bar.** The expanded island's minimum height is 84 pt,
  which fits one row; asking for a second row while a turn runs collapsed the lower region and left the pill with
  nothing but the bot's name. The bottom row now appears only when the turn has finished — status and a clipped
  line of the reply — so a running turn is name plus timer, and a finished one is name, elapsed and what was said.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the pairing code shown by your Hermes host to connect this device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hermes connects to your own Hermes host over your private network.
